text:
Jules (AE): Prospect asks for a 14-day pilot: EU-only data plane, BYOK, and a dated subprocessor snapshot. They want no automatic cross-border failover. Can we scope this quickly?
Kenji (SE): Quick Q: control-plane ok if it's metadata-only?
Jules (AE): Legal said yes for metadata-only control-plane. Payloads, logs, traces must stay in EU.
Marta (Ops): We can pin tenant to eu-west-1 and limit routing to EU pools. BYOK via KMS connector in eu-west exists. BYO-HSM not feasible for a short pilot. Need to check which quantized variants are present in EU.
Renee (Security): I'll prepare the POC attestation and SCQ answers. Ops must provide a dated subprocessor snapshot (storage, infra, monitoring) and confirm observability endpoints. I'll add a clause: 24h notice required before any cross-border failover.
Owen (Pricing): Single-region pinning + BYOK and reserved capacity will add cost. Preliminary two-week estimate: 800,000. I'll formalize once we pick pool size.
Kenji (SE): Proposed POC checklist:
- duration: 14 days
- tenant residency: pinned eu-west-1 (eu-central warm standby inside EU)
- BYOK: customer supplies key ARN -> map via connector
- subprocessors: ops to provide dated snapshot for pilot window
- routing: strict_pin=true, fallback=queue_notify; manual failover only with written approval
- observability: EU-only sinks + redaction applied
Marta (Ops): Implementation snippet:
```
tenant: prospect-poc-2026
residency: EU
primary_pool: eu-west-1
standby_pool: eu-central-1
kms: external_key_arn -> map
routing: strict_pin=true, fallback=queue_notify
observability: sink=obs-eu.redwood, trace_redaction=on
```
Marta (Ops): Note: strict_pin limits autoscale to EU capacity. If we hit max we will queue or return 429. Manual failover requires signed approval and 24h notice per attestation.
Jules (AE): Customer accepts queuing for the pilot but asks for an escalation contact list and an agreement to coordinate manual failover with 24h notice.
Renee (Security): Ops please confirm trace export endpoints and whether we can enable per-tenant redaction today. I'll include those details in the attestation.
Marta (Ops): Current default export is obs.redwood.global. We can flip this tenant to obs-eu.redwood and enable redaction. I'll produce the subprocessor CSV snapshot dated for the pilot. Will schedule the config change in a short maintenance window.
deploy-bot: residency-pin apply requested for tenant prospect-poc-2026 -> job#9876 queued
Owen (Pricing): I'll post the formal quote link once ready.
Kenji (SE): I'll prepare an eval harness and a short sample prompt set so they can compare model quality/latency across EU vs global variants.
Jules (AE): Action items: Kenji draft tech packet + eval set. Marta produce subprocessors list + runbook. Renee finalize attestation & SCQ. Owen send quote. Aim to send customer packet tomorrow AM.
